apps.name: Simulated Learning
apps.description: Adaptive ML/AI learning with interactive simulations and sandboxed code execution inside lessons.
capabilities: run Python code in a one-shot sandbox for lesson practice
answer in-lesson questions grounded in the current concept's theory
example_tasks: practice a machine-learning concept by running example code
ask a question about the current lesson's theory
when_not: not for LLM or transformer theory questions (use stanford-llm)
not for general non-code topics (use teach-me)

operations.name: execute_code
operations.description: Run a one-shot Python snippet and return stdout/stderr (lesson practice; runs in-process, not a hard sandbox).

operations.name: ask_question
operations.description: Answer an in-lesson question grounded in the current concept's theory (LLM).

apps.name: ArXiv Paper Guide
apps.description: Discover and analyze AI research papers from arXiv and external URLs.
capabilities: search arXiv by free-text query or by topic
fetch a paper's full details by arXiv id
analyze a paper (summary, key takeaways, ELI5, concepts, or Q&A)
fetch and parse a paper from a URL (non-arXiv sources included)
example_tasks: find recent papers on mixture-of-experts
summarize the key takeaways of an arXiv paper
explain a specific paper in simple terms
when_not: only for research papers (arXiv or a paper URL); not for teaching a concept from scratch (use teach-me or a subject tutor)
not for general web facts or AI news (use web-search or ai-intelligence-deck)

operations.name: search_papers_by_query
operations.description: Search arXiv by free-text query; upserts and returns matched papers.

operations.name: search_papers_by_topic
operations.description: Search arXiv by topic (mapped to a category), ranked.

operations.name: get_paper_by_id
operations.description: Fetch a paper's full details by arXiv id (from DB or arxiv.org).

operations.name: analyze_paper
operations.description: Analyze a stored paper via LLM. mode: summary|takeaways|eli5|concepts|qa (qa needs question). Paper must be persisted first.

operations.name: chat_about_paper
operations.description: Multi-turn chat about a stored paper (or general) via LLM.

operations.name: fetch_url_paper
operations.description: Fetch and parse a paper from an arbitrary URL (PDF/HTML) — no LLM. Chain into analyze_url_paper.

operations.name: analyze_url_paper
operations.description: Analyze already-fetched URL-paper content via LLM. mode as in analyze_paper.

apps.name: Coding Playground
apps.description: Manage a persistent Jupyter kernel (status/start/restart/interrupt) and browse or preview built-in practice datasets. (Running code is WebSocket-only and not yet exposed to the orchestrator.)
capabilities: check, start, restart, or interrupt the persistent Jupyter kernel
list available datasets and preview them (head, dtypes, shape, stats)
example_tasks: check the coding kernel status
list the available practice datasets
preview the first rows of the Titanic dataset
when_not: does NOT run arbitrary Python over REST (the kernel is WebSocket-only) — to execute a code snippet use simulated-learning
only for kernel status/control and browsing or previewing built-in datasets

operations.name: get_kernel_status
operations.description: Check the Jupyter kernel status (alive/idle/dead).

operations.name: start_kernel
operations.description: Start the Jupyter kernel if not running.

operations.name: restart_kernel
operations.description: Restart the kernel — clears all in-memory state.

operations.name: interrupt_kernel
operations.description: Interrupt (SIGINT) the running kernel execution.

operations.name: list_datasets
operations.description: List available datasets (trailing slash required).

operations.name: preview_dataset
operations.description: Preview a dataset by id (n_rows query param, default 100).

apps.name: AI Intelligence Deck
apps.description: AI news aggregation and trend-intelligence dashboard.
capabilities: get cached AI news items organized by category
generate a TL;DR executive summary of current AI news
analyze trends across the cached AI news corpus
example_tasks: what is the latest in AI news
summarize this week's AI developments
what trends are emerging across AI news
when_not: not for social-media content such as Twitter/X or Medium (use social-media-ai)
for curated AI news and trends only, not arbitrary web facts (use web-search)

operations.name: get_cached_news_by_category
operations.description: Return cached AI news organized by category (news/visionaries/tweets). No LLM.

operations.name: generate_tldr_summary
operations.description: Generate a TL;DR executive summary from cached articles (LLM). provider: openai|gemini.

operations.name: get_trends
operations.description: Detect trending topics across cached articles (LLM). provider: openai|gemini.

apps.name: Social Media AI
apps.description: Aggregates and categorizes social content from Twitter/X, Medium, and other platforms.
capabilities: get the latest aggregated Twitter/X content
get the latest aggregated Medium content
get content across all platforms in one call
list the content categories currently classified
example_tasks: what is trending on Twitter about AI
show me recent Medium posts
aggregate social media content across platforms
when_not: not for curated AI news headlines or an executive news summary (use ai-intelligence-deck)
for Twitter/X and Medium aggregation only

operations.name: get_all_feeds
operations.description: Fetch + categorize Twitter and Medium in one call (Tavily search + LLM); slowest.

operations.name: get_twitter_feed
operations.description: Fetch + categorize latest Twitter/X content (Tavily search + LLM).

operations.name: get_medium_feed
operations.description: Fetch + categorize latest Medium content (Tavily search + LLM).

operations.name: get_categories
operations.description: Return the static list of content categories. No search/LLM.

apps.name: Stanford LLM Course
apps.description: Chatbot assistant grounded in Stanford CME 295 (Transformers & Large Language Models) course material.
capabilities: answer questions about the Stanford CME 295 Transformers/LLM course, grounded in course materials
hold a multi-turn conversation with the course assistant
example_tasks: explain self-attention using the Stanford course
help me study transformers with CME 295 materials
when_not: only Transformers and LLMs (Stanford CME 295) — for statistics use stats-teacher, for other topics use teach-me

operations.name: chat_with_assistant
operations.description: Send the full conversation history to the CME 295 course assistant and get a grounded reply (LLM). Multi-turn is client-managed via the messages array.

apps.name: Statistics Teacher
apps.description: Interactive statistics tutor that answers questions grounded in specific course modules.
capabilities: answer a statistics question grounded in a specific course module, with conversation context
example_tasks: explain hypothesis testing
help me understand p-values
when_not: only statistics — for LLM or transformer topics use stanford-llm, for other topics use teach-me

operations.name: ask_question
operations.description: Answer a stats question grounded in a course module with conversation context (LLM). Streams text/plain chunks — aggregate the body, not JSON.

apps.name: Teach Me
apps.description: Adaptive first-principles learning with generated concept maps and conversational lessons.
capabilities: list learning topics already started
fetch a topic with its concept map and message history
start a new learning topic (generates a concept map and first lesson)
continue a lesson by sending a message grounded in the concept map
example_tasks: teach me a new topic from first principles
start learning about reinforcement learning
continue my lesson on backpropagation
when_not: not for LLM/transformer questions (use stanford-llm) or statistics (use stats-teacher) — those specialists fit better
use Teach Me for general topics that have no dedicated specialist app

operations.name: list_topics
operations.description: List learning topics already started (most recent first).

operations.name: get_topic
operations.description: Fetch a topic with its concept map and full message history.

operations.name: create_topic
operations.description: Start a new topic — generates concept map + first lesson via a multi-agent pipeline (long-running).

operations.name: send_user_message
operations.description: Continue a lesson with a grounded teaching reply (LLM). Persists the turn; non-empty content required.

apps.name: Github Learnings
apps.description: Ingests GitHub repositories and extracts learnings and patterns with searchable Q&A.
capabilities: ingest a GitHub repository (clone, parse, index)
list ingested repositories and their status
list extracted learnings, optionally filtered by repo
free-text search across extracted learnings
example_tasks: learn how a GitHub repo implements a feature
ingest a repo and extract its key patterns
search what I have learned from repositories
when_not: only for GitHub repositories — not for research papers (use arxiv-papers) or general web search

operations.name: list_repos
operations.description: List every ingested repository with status and metadata.

operations.name: ingest_repository
operations.description: Clone, parse, chunk, embed and index a GitHub repo — synchronous and long-running.

operations.name: list_learnings
operations.description: List extracted learnings, optionally filtered by repo_id (query param).

operations.name: search_learnings
operations.description: Free-text search across learnings (SQLite LIKE). Required 'q' query param; empty q -> 400.

apps.name: Blogs Playground
apps.description: Drafts and refines personal blog posts through a multi-stage writing pipeline in the user's voice.
capabilities: list existing blog posts
fetch a blog with its full body and versions
suggest blog topics that fit the user's voice
draft a complete blog post (plan, research, write, critique, polish)
refine an existing blog with a natural-language instruction
example_tasks: draft a blog post about agentic AI
suggest blog topics in my voice
revise my blog to be more concise
when_not: for drafting or refining personal blog posts in the user's voice — not for long-form cited research reports (use research-assistant)

operations.name: list_blogs
operations.description: List existing blog posts (summary metadata).

operations.name: get_blog
operations.description: Fetch a blog by id with full body, history and versions array.

operations.name: suggest_topics
operations.description: Suggest unwritten topics in the writer's voice (LLM). limit query param (default 5, max 12).

operations.name: generate_blog_async
operations.description: Submit a full draft-pipeline run in the background; returns run_id immediately. Poll get_run for the finished blog.

operations.name: iterate_blog_async
operations.description: Submit a natural-language refine of an existing blog in the background; returns run_id. Poll get_run.

operations.name: get_run
operations.description: Poll a generate/iterate run by run_id; when complete it carries the finished blog.

apps.name: Research Assistant
apps.description: Conducts long-form research synthesis with configurable depth and voice over a personal source corpus.
capabilities: start a research run on a topic with configurable depth and voice
list and fetch research runs with their output and sources
manage a corpus of uploaded source documents
list saved research notes and cancel in-flight runs
example_tasks: research the state of the art in retrieval-augmented generation and synthesize a report
run a deep research pass on a topic with citations
when_not: for long-form cited research synthesis — not for short personal blog posts (use blogs-playground)

operations.name: start_research
operations.description: Start a research run (fire-and-forget); returns run_id. depth: child|smart|expert; voice: default|feynman|new_yorker|indian_uncle. Poll get_run.

operations.name: list_runs
operations.description: List recent research runs (most recent first); each carries latest output_md.

operations.name: get_run
operations.description: Fetch a run by id: {run, versions} with output_md and sources per version.

operations.name: cancel_run
operations.description: Cancel an in-flight research run by id.

operations.name: list_notes
operations.description: List saved research notes (commonplace book); optional q text filter.

operations.name: list_corpus_documents
operations.description: List uploaded source documents in the corpus.

operations.name: upload_corpus_document
operations.description: Upload a source document (multipart/form-data) into the corpus; extracts, chunks, ingests. Max 30 MB.

operations.name: delete_corpus_document
operations.description: Delete a source document from the corpus by id.

apps.name: Web Search (fallback)
apps.description: General web lookup for subtasks that no built-in app covers.
capabilities: answer general questions or fetch live facts from the open web when no specialized app applies
